assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: portrait editorial photograph for the enterprise section of a French style consulting website. Create a new original photograph inspired by a small intimate style and color workshop in a beautiful European creative meeting room. Six adult colleagues, women and men aged 30-55, seated naturally around a pale oak table, a female facilitator standing at its far end and demonstrating a fan of ivory, soft rose, burgundy and taupe fabric swatches. View from slightly above table level near the end of the table, participants largely seen from behind or in three-quarter profile, no one looking at camera. Tall windows at left, warm cream plaster walls, simple pendant lights, one small vase of foliage and a few plain notebooks. Thoughtful engaged atmosphere, spontaneous gestures, realistic natural human anatomy. Quiet elegant documentary photography, warm natural window light, realistic subtle texture, restrained color palette of cream, charcoal and burgundy accents. Portrait 4:5 composition, people clustered within the middle and lower 70 percent, generous depth of field. This is an illustrative scene, not a portrait of a particular real person and not a reenactment of an actual event. No logos, no recognizable brands, no lettering or signage, no projected slides, no watermark, no graphic overlays, no collage. Produce a single photographic image.

No text, logo, monogram, recognizable designer hardware, brand marks, watermark, captions or graphic overlays. Produce one photograph, not a collage.
